defects.title: Skip link target is not focusable
defects.repro: On /, Tab to Skip to content, press Enter, inspect focus; main has no tabindex=-1.

defects.title: Duplicate-name and graph navigation are opaque and ID-first
defects.repro: Create two same-named artifacts, search identical content, and inspect graph target labels; only opaque IDs reliably disambiguate.

defects.title: Create form lacks type-detection, binary, and size guidance
defects.repro: First visit, tab through Name, Type, File, Content, Reason; no explanatory help appears.

defects.title: Search modes lack plain-language distinction
defects.repro: Compare Search documents and files with Exact text; indexed syntax and literal/non-regex behavior are not explained.

defects.title: Version and chunk controls lack human context
defects.repro: On a multi-version artifact, tab through Versions and Chunks; labels omit version ordinals and offset units.

defects.title: Authenticated artifact view is hardcoded as Local workspace
defects.repro: Render ui_html with authenticated state and active account; header still contains Local workspace.

defects.title: Admin controls have no discoverable UI
defects.repro: From /, inspect navigation and try /admin; only Workspace/Find and artifact-scoped controls exist.

defects.title: Connection management has no UI entry point
defects.repro: From /, search navigation, sections, and routes for connection/connector management; none exists.

defects.title: Share control uses opaque person IDs and is artifact-context-only
defects.repro: Open an artifact and tab to People with access; recipient is a raw person-id with no member/group or scope guidance.

review.mayor_decision: Keep gate open. Retest exact release build after fl-urj.6.2/.7.7 and declared dependencies land; no closure or enterprise-readiness claim.
